Earth → Milky Way → Solar System → Universe
Universe → Earth → Milky Way → Solar System
Earth → Solar System → Milky Way → Universe

questions.question_en: A question asks for the planet nearest to Earth without a date or distance convention. What is the best assessment?
questions.question_te: తేదీ లేదా దూర ప్రమాణం లేకుండా Earthకు nearest planet అడిగితే సరైన అంచనా ఏది?
options: Mercury is nearest at every instant
Venus is nearest at every instant
It needs a time or distance convention
option_explanations: A time-average claim is not an every-instant claim.
Close approaches do not mean nearest at every instant.
Neptune is not always nearest to Earth.
Instantaneous distance, closest approach and time-average are different measures.
questions.explanation_te: Nearest-to-Earthకు measurement convention అవసరం; Sunకు nearest Mercury.

Planet కాంతి ప్రధానంగా reflected sunlight; నక్షత్రం స్వయంగా శక్తిని విడుదల చేస్తుంది.

questions.question_en: Which sequence best represents solar-system formation?
questions.question_te: సౌర కుటుంబ పుట్టుకకు సరైన క్రమం ఏది?
options: Earth forms → Universe forms → gas disappears
Finished planets → dust cloud → Sun disappears

Comet tails are not the start of galaxy formation.
Earth did not form before the Universe.
Planets do not precede their source cloud in this model.
questions.explanation_te: Cloud కుంచించుకుని disk ఏర్పడి, పదార్థం చేరి bodies పెరిగాయి.
